title: Qasim ke janaaze pe
body:
Qasim ke janaaze pe
[Haaye Qasim, haay haay qasim, shahzada mera qasim] ×2
[Qasim ke janaaze pe kya dard ka manzar hai] ×3
Roti hai phuphi uski, haaye roti hai phuphi uski, nawhaa kuna madar hai
[Qasim ke janaaze pe kya dard ka manzar hai] ×2
(Sab khu(n) me bharaa sehra poshaak darida hai) x2
Pamaal badan saara, haaye pamaale badan saraa, aur khaak ka bistar hai
[Qasim ke janaaze pe kya dard ka manzar hai] ×2
[Mehndi hai lahu wali nawhshaah ke haatho mei] ×2
Saaye ke liye sar par, haaye saaye ke liye sar par, bas dhoop ki chadar hai
[Qasim ke janaaze pe kya dard ka manzar hai] ×2
[Tukre tha jigar jese ay maula hassan tera] ×2
Tukro mei yahaa maula, haaye tukro me yahaa maula, waise tera dilbar hai
[Qasim ke janaaze pe kya dard ka manzar hai] ×2
(Maa kehti thi qasim ki ay laal kahaan jawu(n)) x2
G(h)ayre huwe khaymo ko, haaye G(h)ayre huwe khaymo ko, kuffar ka lashkar hai
[Qasim ke janaaze pe kya dard ka manzar hai] ×2
(Ik gathri me laate hai(n) shabbir ye kya ran se) x2
Awaaze falak ayi, haaye awaaze falak aayi, lakhte dile shabbar hai
[Qasim ke janaaze pe kya dard ka manzar hai] ×2
[Behno ne kiya matam qasim ke janaaze par] ×2
Masroofe fughaa saari, haaye masroofe fugha saari, awlaade payambar hai
[Qasim ke janaaze pe kya dard ka manzar hai] ×2
(Shah kehte the ay qasim kyu(n) tuj ko ajal ayi) x2
Sine me mere beta, haaye sine me mere beta, ik dard ka khanjar hai
[Qasim ke janaaze pe kya dard ka manzar hai] ×2
[Bikhra hai tera sehra jalti huwi reyti par] ×2
Har phool ki ankho(n) me, haaye har phool ki ankho(n) me, ashko ka samandar hai
[Qasim ke janaaze pe kya dard ka manzar hai] ×2
("Rehan" zaraa socho laashe to bahattar hai(n)) x2
Rone ke liye tanha, haaye rone ke liye tanha, "Shabbir" ki khahar hai
[Qasim ke janaaze pe kya dard ka manzar hai] ×2
